question: Name the tallest superhero.
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT superhero_name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS __r FROM superhero) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 1

d.request: Which superheroes have the greatest height in centimeters? Return all who tie for tallest.
d.sql: SELECT superhero_name, height_cm FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);

c.sql: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);

b.request: Return the superhero_name of every superhero whose height_cm equals the maximum height_cm in the superhero table, including all ties
b.sql: SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero)
